accountName.title: Storage Account Name
accountName.description: Azure Storage account name (the storage account itself, NOT the friendly FileStorageAccount name), e.g. mystorageacct

accountKey.title: Account Key
accountKey.description: Azure Storage account access key (key1 or key2). Full-control secret — rotate periodically.

defaultContainer.title: Container
defaultContainer.description: Blob container name to store objects in, e.g. mj-archives
